hero.title: NQ target intelligence your desk can evaluate.
hero.description: Harper Vance publishes qualifying intraday NQ targets and preserves the complete record: current targets, daily outcomes, weekly behavior, and historical comparisons. Trading, research, and oversight can evaluate the intelligence over time.

record.label: Representative record format
record.footnote: Example format. Not a live or historical result.

included.title: One subscription. A complete record from target to review.
included.description: Harper Vance delivers the same core intelligence across every license. Access, delivery methods, history, and internal usage rights scale with your firm.
included.qualification: Targets are published only when predefined conditions qualify. A session may produce no targets.

artifacts.title: During the session
artifacts.description: Qualifying NQ targets are published with direction, timestamp, and session context through approved delivery channels.

artifacts.title: After the session
artifacts.description: Every target is retained with its recorded outcome and included in the completed-session email report.

artifacts.title: Over time
artifacts.description: Weekly summaries and historical views help your team evaluate behavior across completed sessions.

problem.title: If the original call cannot be reviewed, it cannot be evaluated.
problem.description: Targets scattered across messages and after-the-fact recaps leave a desk guessing. Harper Vance keeps the issued target, its context, and its outcome together.
problem.belief: Your team sees what was generated, not a rewritten version of the session.
items: Reached and unreached outcomes stay visible
Daily and weekly records follow the same format

operations.title: Review the intelligence from one controlled system of record.
operations.description: Authorized users can review current targets, completed-session analysis, weekly summaries, and historical behavior without changing the desk's execution workflow.
operations.delivery: Secure dashboard and email delivery are included. Eligible licenses may include approved API and webhook access. Slack or Microsoft Teams delivery is not included until technical setup is certified.
operations.integrity: Partial periods, small samples, unresolved targets, and unavailable aggregates remain visible so teams can interpret the record with its limitations intact.
operations.boundary: Built for review and governance, not order entry or execution.

items.title: Today's Targets
items.description: Review current and unresolved targets with their original issue details, live session status, and recorded outcomes.

items.title: Daily Performance Record
items.description: Examine the complete daily target log, session replay, timing, retraction, and session-period behavior.

items.title: Weekly Summary
items.description: Review week-level outcomes, timing, retraction patterns, daily variation, and sample-aware comparisons.

items.title: Historical & Rolling
items.description: Compare rolling trends, directional behavior, and day-by-day records across retained history.

evidence.title: See the record, then decide if it fits your desk.
evidence.description: A qualified evaluation starts with the completed-session deliverable, continues with a workflow review, and ends with a clear go or no-go decision. No trading result or return is promised.
